summary: Frontend-only test of the Magazzino 'today only' front page (390x844) and the /api/sito Arrivi tab. Server and browser date: 2026-11-17 15:25 UTC. All requested flows PASS. On open, the 'Oggi' date chip and the 'Da scaricare' status chip are active, and the list holds only today's 3 orders (25024256, 25024264, 25024265; 15 rows). magazzino-ritardi-count shows '27 pedane in ritardo' and the sub text '9 posizioni · 2164 colli'. magazzino-da-scaricare-count shows '27 pedane da scaricare' with '3 ordini · 9 posizioni · 2164 colli'. These match a sum computed independently from GET /api/pedane/tutte: 27 pallets (rows with numeroPedane '0' count 0), 9 positions and 2164 colli. Pallet sums are also shown on the date chips (Tutte 1254, Oggi 27, Domani 38) and the status chips. Typing a search switches the date chip to Tutte, and clearing the search returns to Oggi with 27 again. Tapping the Tutte date chip shows all days (1254 pedane, 194 orders); the ritardi banner still counts only today. Domani shows 38. On the office site, Arrivi defaults to today and the badges read '27 pedane · 2164 colli / 0 scaricate / 0 parziali / 27 da scaricare'. The table has Pedane and Colli columns with the PDF values, and switching to 2026-11-18 shows 38 pedane · 4000 colli. Found only minor consistency and design issues.

ui_bugs.issue: During a search the text uses filtered.length (rows), while the chips show pallet sums. Searching '25024265' shows '9 pedane trovate', but the Oggi chip and the group summary say 13 pedane. Reference: /app/frontend/app/magazzino.tsx:347
done/all counts rows, not pallets. Order 25024256 shows '0/3' next to '9 pedane', and order 25024265 shows '0/9' next to '13 pedane'. Reference: magazzino.tsx:350-354,373

The group 'pal' uses parseInt(numeroPedane)||0, so empty numeroPedane counts 0 and the 'N pedane' part is hidden, while totPedane counts an empty value as 1. Old orders such as 25023482 show no pedane in the group header but add 1 each to the banner and chip totals. Reference: magazzino.tsx:353 vs 541
'Torna ai 3 risultati' uses results.length (rows) even though the search matched a single position. Reference: magazzino.tsx:311

issues: Date and status filter chips are 36px high, under the 44px minimum touch target (styles.chip height 36). The operatore pill is 40px high.

action_items: magazzino.tsx:347: use totPedane(filtered) for the search results count, or label it as rows/merci.
magazzino.tsx:353: use totPedane(g.items) for the group 'pal' so it matches the banners and chips.
Optional: make the group progress pill count pallets (e.g. totPedane done / totPedane all), and raise the chip height to 44.
critical_code_review_comments: isoDay() is computed from device local time on each render. The 20s live refresh re-renders, so the day rolls over at midnight. OK.
The search effect resets dataFiltro on each q change, so a date chip the user picked during a search is lost after any further keystroke. This is acceptable per the spec.
The ritardi banner uses dateFiltered, so when Domani is selected the banner is hidden even if pallets are late today. This is acceptable, because the default view is Oggi.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (4 minor consistency bugs, 1 design issue)
